semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Kematek specializes in advanced ceramic materials and components that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and related industries.
summary: Suzhou Kematek, Inc. develops and produces advanced ceramic materials and components tailored for the semiconductor and electronics industries. Their vertically integrated manufacturing facilities offer comprehensive solutions, particularly for high-end equipment manufacturing.
capabilities: Advanced ceramic materials for semiconductor applications
Ceramic fixtures and components for wafer handling
Flow control components including valves and regulators

regional_presence.China: The company combines technology and management expertise from Silicon Valley with local talent in China to enhance its manufacturing capabilities.
